newsitem.title: SPAIN: GOLF-TORRANCE DISQUALIFIED FROM EUROPEAN TOUR EVENT.
newsitem.headline: GOLF-TORRANCE DISQUALIFIED FROM EUROPEAN TOUR EVENT.

text.p: Ryder Cup player Sam Torrance was disqualified from the Oki Pro-Am when he failed to arrive on time for the opening round of the European Tour event on Thursday.
The 43-year-old Scot was due to be second off on the La Moraleja One course with Manuel Ballesteros, Seve's older brother, but slept in at his Madrid hotel.
Torrance has only just returned from Korea, where he finished third in a tournament last week, and may have had problems adjusting to the time difference.
Fellow Briton Andrew Barnett, the first reserve for this event, was on the course before the start of play and was called in to take Torrance's place.
